profile.headline: look, an axolotl ᗒ._____.ᗕ​
profile.summary: Software engineer with 10+ years of experience working on a wide range of codebases, technologies, and positions. Skilled at rapidly adapting to new systems, building scalable solutions, mentoring teammates, and solving problems in a customer-centric manner.

positions.title: Intern/New Grad Hiring Manager
positions.description: I worked with interviewers to determine hire/no hire decision for Intern and New Grad candidates. I gave frequent consultations on difficult hiring dilemmas that others Intern/New Grad HMs faced.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: TypeScript · JavaScript · React.js · Scala · Swift (Programming Language) · SwiftUI · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · SCSS · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Web On-call Lead
positions.description: I lead the Web On-call team and scaled the rotation from a single office, ad hoc system into a robust, formalized team, beholden to goals and OKRs, spread across multiple regions with 20+ engineers. I developed a separate process and responsibility for the training pipeline to the Web On-call rotation.
